purpose: Canonical report map for the native exact solver validation artifacts referenced by the thesis.

corner_pdb_enabled.description: Primary thesis validation run with the full native corner pattern database enabled. Reproduction requires a complete data/pattern_databases/corner_db.pkl artifact; the source ZIP may omit this generated cache and should then fail hard rather than silently degrading.

corner_pdb_disabled_baseline.description: Matched baseline run on the same corpus with the full native corner pattern database disabled.

reproducibility.source_zip_reproducibility: The canonical preset requires data/pattern_databases/corner_db.pkl, which is intentionally omitted from source ZIPs. Use --preset source-zip for a cache-free smoke check; use the canonical preset only after generating or supplying the full corner cache.

report_schema.config.corpus_generation: preserved in every new report emitted by the validation harness
report_schema.config.corner_db_loaded: true only when the full corner pattern database was actually loaded
report_schema.config.corner_db_complete: true only when the loaded corner pattern database covers every state

pre_corner_pdb_zero_failure_run.description: Earlier 3509-case validation run with zero failures.

depth8_followup.description: Two-case follow-up run with zero failures.

depth9_timeout_boundary.description: Two-case sampled boundary run showing native timeouts at depth 9 under the 20-second limit.

legacy_reports.pattern: native_exact_validation_20260322_12*.json and native_exact_validation_20260322_143*.json excluding the canonical pair
legacy_reports.description: Historical exploratory outputs kept for traceability. They predate the richer report schema and should not be cited as the final thesis evidence when a canonical report exists.

thesis_claims_supported: The native exact solver is validated on a reproducible 3513-case corpus.
Enabling the full native corner PDB reduces failures under a 20-second limit from 3 to 1.
One edge-dominated depth-8 timeout remains in the corner-PDB-enabled run.
